Regulatory Authority Isomorphism formalizes how institutional memory is encoded into enduring structures. Data Preservation Kernel captures the essence of maintaining partial yet useful datasets for managerial decision-making. Operational Continuity Protocol models the inter-committee communication required for consistent rule enforcement. These operators exhibit duality in that they both define and constrain the space of possible rule configurations. Failure modes arise when any one operator breaks down—loss of authority leads to chaos, loss of data undermines planning, and loss of continuity disrupts coordination.
